formulas.value: Average PHQ-9 Score by Facility (APSF): APSF = \frac{\sum_{i \in assessmentsymptomsandrisk} (mental\_health\_scores_i['depression']['phq9\_score'])} {|assessmentsymptomsandrisk|}

Average GAD-7 Score by Facility (AGSF): AGSF = \frac{\sum_{i \in assessmentsymptomsandrisk} (mental\_health\_scores_i['anxiety']['gad7\_score'])} {|assessmentsymptomsandrisk|}, \text{where } mental\_health\_scores_i['anxiety']['gad7\_score'] \text{ is the GAD-7 score for each assessment in the assessmentsymptomsandrisk table, linked to a facility via encounters.facid}
Treatment Adherence Rate (TAR): TAR = \frac{|treatmentoutcomes \text{ with } txadh \in \{High, Medium\}|} {|treatmentoutcomes|}
Suicide Risk Prevalence (SRP): SRP = \frac{|assessmentsymptomsandrisk \text{ with } suicrisk \in \{High, Severe\}|} {|assessmentsymptomsandrisk|} \times 100

Therapy Engagement Score (TES): TES = \frac{\sum_{i \in treatmentbasics} (therapy\_details_i['engagement\_score'])} {|treatmentbasics|}, \text{where } engagement\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } therapy\_details['engagement'] = High \\ 2 & \text{if } therapy\_details['engagement'] = Medium \\ 1 & \text{if } therapy\_details['engagement'] = Low \\ 0 & \text{if } therapy\_details['engagement'] = Non-compliant \end{cases}, \text{and } therapy\_details \text{ is the JSONB column in the treatmentbasics table}

Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI): FRAI = \frac{\sum_{i \in facilities} resource\_score_i} {|facilities|}, \text{where } resource\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } support\_and\_resources['community\_resources'] = Comprehensive \\ 2 & \text{if } support\_and\_resources['community\_resources'] = Adequate \\ 1 & \text{if } support\_and\_resources['community\_resources'] = Limited \end{cases}, \text{and } support\_and\_resources \text{ is the JSONB column in the facilities table}

Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS): PFIS = \frac{\sum_{i \in assessmentsocialanddiagnosis} funcimp\_score_i} {|assessmentsocialanddiagnosis|}, \text{where } funcimp\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } funcimp = Severe \\ 2 & \text{if } funcimp = Moderate \\ 1 & \text{if } funcimp = Mild \end{cases}
Crisis Intervention Frequency (CIF): CIF = \frac{\sum_{i \in treatmentbasics} crisisint_i} {|patients|}

Social Support Effectiveness (SSE): SSE = \frac{\sum_{i \in assessmentsocialanddiagnosis} (socsup\_score_i + relqual\_score_i)} {|assessmentsocialanddiagnosis|}, \text{where } socsup\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } socsup = Strong \\ 2 & \text{if } socsup = Moderate \\ 1 & \text{if } socsup = Limited \end{cases}, \text{and } relqual\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } relqual = Good \\ 2 & \text{if } relqual = Fair \\ 1 & \text{if } relqual = Poor \\ 0 & \text{if } relqual = Conflicted \end{cases}
Missed Appointment Rate (MAR): MAR = \frac{\sum_{i \in encounters} missappt_i} {|patients|}
High-Risk Patient: A patient with suicrisk \in \{High, Severe\} or mental\_health\_scores['depression']['phq9\_score'] > 15 or mental\_health\_scores['anxiety']['gad7\_score'] > 15,
Treatment-Resistant Patient: A patient with txresp = Poor and txadh \in \{Medium, High\}
Complex Care Needs: A patient with SRP > 20\% and PFIS > 2.5 and subuse \in \{Opioids, Multiple\}
Stable Recovery Patient: A patient with recstatus = Stable and funcimpv \in \{Moderate, Significant\}

Resource-Supported Facility: A facility with resource_score \geq 2 \text{where } resource_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } support\_and\_resources['community\_resources'] = Comprehensive \\ 2 & \text{if } support\_and\_resources['community\_resources'] = Adequate \\ 1 & \text{if } support\_and\_resources['community\_resources'] = Limited \end{cases}.
Non-Compliant Patient: A patient with txadh = Non-compliant and medadh = Non-compliant
High Appointment Adherence: A patient with MAR < 1
PHQ-9 Score (Depression): Ranges from 0 to 27. A score of 0–4 indicates minimal depression, 5–9 mild, 10–14 moderate, 15–19 moderately severe, and 20–27 severe.
GAD-7 Score (Anxiety): Ranges from 0 to 21. A score of 0–4 indicates minimal anxiety, 5–9 mild, 10–14 moderate, and 15–21 severe.
Suicide Risk Level: Ranges from Low to Severe. Low indicates minimal risk, Medium indicates some concern, High indicates immediate concern, and Severe indicates urgent intervention needed.

Therapy Engagement: Ranges from Non-compliant to High. Non-compliant indicates no participation, Low indicates minimal participation, Medium indicates regular participation, and High indicates active engagement.
Community Resources: Ranges from Limited to Comprehensive. Limited indicates few or no resources, Adequate indicates sufficient resources, and Comprehensive indicates extensive resources.
Functional Impairment: Ranges from Mild to Severe. Mild indicates minimal impact on daily life, Moderate indicates noticeable impact, and Severe indicates significant disruption.

Treatment Adherence: Ranges from Non-compliant to High. Non-compliant indicates no adherence, Low indicates occasional adherence, Medium indicates regular adherence, and High indicates consistent adherence.
Crisis Intervention Count: A numeric value indicating the number of crisis interventions. A value of 0 indicates no interventions, while higher values (e.g., 3) indicate frequent interventions.
Social Support Level: Ranges from Limited to Strong. Limited indicates minimal support, Moderate indicates some support, and Strong indicates robust support.
Missed Appointment Count: A numeric value indicating the number of missed appointments. A value of 0 indicates perfect attendance, while higher values (e.g., 5) indicate frequent absences.
Symptom Severity Index (SSI): SSI = \frac{APSF + AGSF}{2}, \text{using Average PHQ-9 Score (APSF) and Average GAD-7 Score (AGSF)}
Engagement-Adherence Score (EAS): EAS = \frac{TES + (TAR \times 3)}{2}, \text{normalizing Treatment Adherence Rate (TAR) to the Therapy Engagement Score (TES) scale (0-3)}
Facility Risk Profile Index (FRPI): FRPI = (\frac{SRP}{100} \times 5) + PFIS, \text{weighting Suicide Risk Prevalence (SRP) and combining with Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS)}
Patient Stability Metric (PSM): PSM = \frac{1}{1 + CIF + MAR}, \text{where higher values indicate greater stability based on Crisis Intervention Frequency (CIF) and Missed Appointment Rate (MAR)}
Resource-Demand Differential (RDD): RDD = PFIS - FRAI, \text{comparing Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS) to Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI)}
Socio-Environmental Support Index (SESI): SESI = \frac{SSE_{avg} + FRAI}{2}, \text{combining average Social Support Effectiveness (SSE) across patients with Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI)}
Adherence Effectiveness Ratio (AER): AER = \frac{TAR}{PFIS}, \text{using Treatment Adherence Rate (TAR) and Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS) (handle PFIS=0)}
Engagement Deficit Index (EDI): EDI = (3 - TES) \times (1 + MAR), \text{calculating the gap from maximum Therapy Engagement Score (TES) weighted by Missed Appointment Rate (MAR)}

Comprehensive Facility Risk Score (CFRS): CFRS = \frac{APSF}{27} + \frac{SRP}{100} + \frac{PFIS}{3}, \text{normalizing Average PHQ-9 Score (APSF), Suicide Risk Prevalence (SRP), and Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS) to a 0-1 scale and summing}

Support System Pressure Index (SSPI): SSPI = \frac{CIF}{SSE_{avg} + 1}, \text{calculating Crisis Intervention Frequency (CIF) relative to average Social Support Effectiveness (SSE) (adding 1 to avoid division by zero)}
High-Need, Under-Resourced Facility: A facility where FRPI > 4.5 and FRAI < 1.5, \text{indicating high Facility Risk Profile Index (FRPI) and low Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI)}

Facility with Engaged but High-Impairment Population: A facility where EAS > 2.0 and PFIS > 2.0, \text{showing high Engagement-Adherence Score (EAS) alongside high Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS)}

Patient with Strong Recovery Capital: A patient where SSE \geq 5 and their funcimp value corresponds to a score of 1 (Mild), potentially indicating strong basis for sustained recovery. Relates to concepts measured by SSE and PFIS.
Facility Attrition Risk Indicator: A facility where EAS < 1.5 and MAR > 2.5, \text{based on low Engagement-Adherence Score (EAS) and high Missed Appointment Rate (MAR)}

Well-Resourced High-Support Environment: A facility where FRAI \geq 2.0 and the average SSE \geq 4.5, \text{indicating high Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI) and high average Social Support Effectiveness (SSE)}

Patient with Severe Comorbid Distress Profile: A patient where mental_health_scores['depression']['phq9_score'] \geq 15 AND mental_health_scores['anxiety']['gad7_score'] \geq 15 AND funcimp = 'Severe'. \text{This profile relates to high individual contributions to APSF, AGSF, and PFIS}.
Facility with Potential Treatment Inertia: A facility where TES > 2.2 and TAR < 0.6, \text{based on Therapy Engagement Score (TES) and Treatment Adherence Rate (TAR)}

Patient with High Crisis & Low Support Profile: A patient where their individual crisisint count (from treatmentbasics table) > 2 AND their individual SSE score (calculated from assessmentsocialanddiagnosis) < 3. \text{This profile relates to high contribution to CIF and low individual SSE}.
Facility Demonstrating Strong Patient Retention: A facility where TAR > 0.75 and MAR < 1.0, \text{based on Treatment Adherence Rate (TAR) and Missed Appointment Rate (MAR)}

High Severity, High Risk Patient Group: A patient where (mental_health_scores['depression']['phq9_score'] > 19 OR mental_health_scores['anxiety']['gad7_score'] > 14) AND suicrisk IN {'High', 'Severe'}.

Clinical Improvement Potential Index (CIPI): CIPI = \frac{EAS}{SSI + 1}, \text{using Engagement-Adherence Score (EAS) and Symptom Severity Index (SSI). Higher values suggest higher engagement relative to current symptom burden.}

Facility Efficiency Index (FEI): FEI = PSM \times FRAI, \text{multiplying Patient Stability Metric (PSM) by Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI). Higher scores suggest better stability achieved per resource level.}

Therapeutic Alliance & Engagement Score (TAES): TAES = \frac{Average(theralliance\_score) + TES}{2}, \text{where } theralliance\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } theralliance = Strong \\ 2 & \text{if } theralliance = Moderate \\ 1 & \text{if } theralliance = Weak \\ 0 & \text{if } theralliance = Poor \end{cases}, \text{averaged across treatmentoutcomes, combined with Therapy Engagement Score (TES)}.

Recovery Trajectory Index (RTI): RTI = \frac{\sum_{i \in treatmentoutcomes} (funcimpv\_score_i)}{|treatmentoutcomes|} \times TAR, \text{where } funcimpv\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } funcimpv = Significant \\ 2 & \text{if } funcimpv = Moderate \\ 1 & \text{if } funcimpv = Minimal \end{cases}

Crisis Adherence Ratio (CAR): CAR = \frac{CIF}{TAR + 0.01}, \text{dividing Crisis Intervention Frequency (CIF) by Treatment Adherence Rate (TAR) (adjusted to prevent division by zero). Higher values indicate more crises relative to adherence levels.}
Facility with High Clinical Leverage Potential: A facility where EAS > 2.5 AND SSI > 15, \text{indicating high Engagement-Adherence Score (EAS) alongside a high Symptom Severity Index (SSI).}

Patient Exhibiting Fragile Stability: A patient meeting Stable Recovery Patient criteria BUT having an average missappt > 2 across their encounters OR an individual SSE score < 3. \text{Combines Stable Recovery Patient status with risk factors related to MAR and SSE}.
Facility with Potential Engagement-Outcome Disconnect: A facility where TES > 2.0 AND RTI < 0.8, \text{indicating high Therapy Engagement Score (TES) but a low Recovery Trajectory Index (RTI).}

Correlation Between Resource Adequacy and Adherence (CRAA): CRAA = \text{CORR}(resource\_score, tar), \text{where } resource\_score \text{ is the facility's resource adequacy score, and } tar \text{ is the treatment adherence rate for the facility.}

Facility Performance Quadrant (FPQ): A facility is assigned to one of four quadrants: 'High Adherence, High Stability' if TAR ≥ median_tar and PSM ≥ median_psm; 'High Adherence, Low Stability' if TAR ≥ median_tar and PSM < median_psm; 'Low Adherence, High Stability' if TAR < median_tar and PSM ≥ median_psm; 'Low Adherence, Low Stability' if TAR < median_tar and PSM < median_psm.

Treatment Adherence Rate (TAR): TAR = \frac{|treatmentoutcomes \text{ with } txadh \in \{High, Medium\}|} {|treatmentoutcomes|}

Patient Functional Impairment Score (PFIS): PFIS = \frac{\sum_{i \in assessmentsocialanddiagnosis} funcimp\_score_i} {|assessmentsocialanddiagnosis|}, \text{where } funcimp\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } funcimp = Severe \\ 2 & \text{if } funcimp = Moderate \\ 1 & \text{if } funcimp = Mild \end{cases}
Crisis Intervention Frequency (CIF): CIF = \frac{\sum_{i \in treatmentbasics} crisisint_i} {|patients|}
Missed Appointment Rate (MAR): MAR = \frac{\sum_{i \in encounters} missappt_i} {|patients|}
High-Risk Patient: A patient with suicrisk \in \{High, Severe\} or mental\_health\_scores['depression']['phq9\_score'] > 15 or mental\_health\_scores['anxiety']['gad7\_score'] > 15,
Treatment-Resistant Patient: A patient with txresp = Poor and txadh \in \{Medium, High\}
Complex Care Needs: A patient with SRP > 20\% and PFIS > 2.5 and subuse \in \{Opioids, Multiple\}
Stable Recovery Patient: A patient with recstatus = Stable and funcimpv \in \{Moderate, Significant\}
Non-Compliant Patient: A patient with txadh = Non-compliant and medadh = Non-compliant
High Appointment Adherence: A patient with MAR < 1
Socio-Environmental Support Index (SESI): SESI = \frac{SSE_{avg} + FRAI}{2}, \text{combining average Social Support Effectiveness (SSE) across patients with Facility Resource Adequacy Index (FRAI)}

Patient with Strong Recovery Capital: A patient where SSE \geq 5 and their funcimp value corresponds to a score of 1 (Mild), potentially indicating strong basis for sustained recovery. Relates to concepts measured by SSE and PFIS.

Social Support Effectiveness (SSE): SSE = \frac{\sum_{i \in assessmentsocialanddiagnosis} (socsup\_score_i + relqual\_score_i)} {|assessmentsocialanddiagnosis|}, \text{where } socsup\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } socsup = Strong \\ 2 & \text{if } socsup = Moderate \\ 1 & \text{if } socsup = Limited \end{cases}, \text{and } relqual\_score = \begin{cases} 3 & \text{if } relqual = Good \\ 2 & \text{if } relqual = Fair \\ 1 & \text{if } relqual = Poor \\ 0 & \text{if } relqual = Conflicted \end{cases}
